text: {"name":"tx_unlock","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Unlocks the transmit path and processes queued TX items by clearing their status, invoking their callbacks under interrupt masking, checking RF TX timestamps, and performing host buffer recovery when requested.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v0":"tx_pending_list_head_ptr","v1":"tx_work_item","v3":"irq_saved_flag_ptr","v4":"tx_active_count_ptr","v5":"inactive_item_seen","v6":"tx_item_callback","v7":"tx_active_count_after","v8":"irq_saved_flag","v9":"wlc_state_flag_ptr"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"next pointer in queued TX item list"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"TX item completion callback pointer"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"callback argument for TX item"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"RF TX timestamp value checked after item callback"},{"offset":16,"meaning":"TX item status byte; bit 0 appears to indicate readiness or active state"},{"offset":69,"meaning":"global WLC TX state flag byte; host buffer recovery request bit"}]}
